name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
summary: Near Auberdine’s docks and inn in Darkshore, Cerellean Whiteclaw rests with grief for a lost love. The Sundering’s memory haunts him, and he struggles to bring that restless spirit peace.

sections.title: A Love Torn asunder
sections.body: Before the War of the Ancients, Cerellean Whiteclaw shared his life with Anaya Dawnrunner. Ten thousand years ago, the demonic invasion shattered ancient Kalimdor, and Anaya died in the destruction of her city, Ameth'Aran. Stricken with grief, Cerellean followed Malfurion Stormrage into the long druidic slumber. The Emerald Dream brought little relief from his memories. When he awoke millennia later, he wandered Darkshore in grief and found Anaya's ghost still bound to the stones where she fell.

sections.title: A Plea for Release
sections.body: Cerellean longs to give Anaya peace, but cannot bear to strike down her tormented shade himself. He asks passing travelers to go south to the haunted ruins of Ameth'Aran, put her spirit to rest, and recover her pendant. Once freed, Anaya's shade briefly visits Cerellean on Auberdine's docks. She reassures him of her enduring love and promises they will one day reunite in the afterlife.

faq.answer: Cerellean Whiteclaw rests near the docks and inn of Auberdine in Darkshore. This ancient night elf mourns Anaya Dawnrunner, who died during the War of the Ancients ten thousand years ago.

Anaya Dawnrunner shared her life with Cerellean Whiteclaw in the ancient city of Ameth'Aran. She died when the city was destroyed during the War of the Ancients, and her tormented spirit lingered among its ruins for thousands of years.

faq.q: Why doesn't Cerellean lay Anaya's spirit to rest himself?
faq.answer: Cerellean is too heartbroken to confront and destroy Anaya's ghost himself. He asks sympathetic travelers to give her spirit its final release.

faq.q: Where are the ruins of Ameth'Aran?
faq.answer: The ruins of Ameth'Aran lie in southern Darkshore, east of the main road. Ghosts of ancient kaldorei who died during the Great Sundering haunt the area.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know Cerellean's grief reflects the deep, lasting scars the War of the Ancients and Great Sundering left upon the kaldorei.
As a druid, you share the long slumber Cerellean entered alongside Malfurion Stormrage. The Emerald Dream could not wash away his earthly heartbreak.
